title: 第2362章 引蛇出洞朝堂锄奸第2361章 肃清灾患尽得民心
content_zh:
莫凡俯瞰下方群臣，唇角微扬，并无半分动怒之意。
他执掌朝堂多年，心如明镜，自然知晓朝中各族臣子暗中抱团、派系林立的局面，而这一切，本就是他暗中默许的格局。
适度的派系制衡、族群竞争，非但不会动摇帝朝根基，反而能盘活朝堂吏治，激励群臣勤勉履职，避免一朝独大、权势固化的弊病。
只是他心中底线从未松动：派系相争、理念分歧皆可包容，唯独不能逾越万古律法，不能损害帝朝根基、背叛帝君社稷！
就在群臣心绪纷乱、议论暗藏之际，十余道隐晦灵光骤然从朝臣队列中腾起，化作细碎光束，欲向大殿四面八方激射而出，显然是有人暗中传讯、私通外敌！
可光束刚一升空，触及大殿穹顶与殿门边界，便被一层无形无色的浩瀚结界死死拦截，灵光瞬间湮灭，尽数溃散虚空，半点无法外泄。
“有人暗中传音泄密！”
变故突生，满殿群臣哗然，目光齐齐锁定那十余名灵光外泄的修士。
莫凡双眸微微一眯，眼底温情尽数收敛，寒意陡生，沉声冷喝：“红眼、喳喳！即刻拿下这群叛国乱贼！”
“属下遵令！”
红眼与喳喳齐声领命，身形瞬间暴掠而出，化作两道残影，径直扑向那几名暗中作祟的修士。
“帝君有令，拿下叛国奸佞！”
两妖厉声大喝，出手迅猛凌厉、毫不留情。
其余文武百官此刻也尽数反应过来，同仇敌忾，纷纷出手围堵余下作乱之人。
方才还略显嘈杂的万古大殿，瞬息陷入乱斗，气机激荡、灵光乱闪。
但这场动荡并未持续多久，仅仅数个呼吸，便彻底尘埃落定、恢复肃静。
整整十余名文臣武将被众人制服，狼狈押至帝座之下，齐齐跪伏在地。
众人抬眸望去，只见这十余人个个披头散发、衣衫凌乱，满身狼狈。
有人嘴角溢血、气息萎靡，有人颜面青肿、狼狈不堪，皆是被当场制服重创。
而这一众叛国泄密之徒中，仅有三名妖族修士，剩余十之七八，尽是此前暗自心存隔阂、暗中非议的人族朝臣。

“汝等可知罪？”
莫凡端坐至高帝座，双眸微眯，声线清淡无波，却裹挟着彻骨寒意，沉沉落遍整座万古大殿。
下方十余名单膝跪地的叛臣身躯齐齐一颤，脊背发凉、心神俱震，却无一人开口认罪，皆心存侥幸、闭口不语，妄图蒙混过关。
“缄默不语，便是认罪。”
莫凡眸光骤冷，一声冷哼响彻朝堂，杀意凛然：“既然不肯认罪伏诛，那便尽数赴死！”
磅礴杀威轰然压落，帝座之下空气凝滞，众叛臣瞬间面如死灰。
生死绝境面前，终于有人彻底绷不住，凄厉哀嚎出声：“帝君饶命！帝君饶命啊！！”
“饶命？”
莫凡眼底怒意翻涌，目光凛冽如刀，死死盯住下方众人，厉声怒斥：“尔等心中贪恋私利、私通外敌、暗藏祸心之时，可曾念过半分万古帝朝的社稷安危、亿万子民的生死存亡？！”
他心中怒火难平。
content_en:
Mo Fan looked down at the ministers below, the corners of his lips slightly raised, and he didn't mean to be angry at all.
He has been in charge of the court for many years, and he has a clear mind. He is naturally aware of the situation in which ministers from all ethnic groups in the court secretly form alliances and have numerous factions. All of this is a pattern that he secretly acquiesces to.
Moderate factional checks and balances and ethnic competition will not shake the foundation of the imperial dynasty, but can invigorate the court's officialdom, encourage ministers to perform their duties diligently, and avoid the shortcomings of one dynasty becoming dominant and consolidating its power.
But the bottom line in his heart has never been loosened: factional disputes and ideological differences can be tolerated, but the eternal laws cannot be exceeded, the foundation of the imperial dynasty cannot be damaged, and the emperor and the country cannot be betrayed!
Just when the ministers were in confusion and discussing secretly, more than ten obscure auras suddenly rose from the ranks of the courtiers and turned into tiny beams of light, trying to shoot out in all directions of the hall. It was obvious that someone was secretly sending a message and communicating with foreign enemies!
But as soon as the beam of light rose into the sky and touched the boundary between the dome of the hall and the door, it was intercepted by a vast invisible and colorless barrier. The aura was instantly annihilated and dissipated into the void, unable to leak out at all.
"Someone secretly transmitted the message and leaked the secret!"
Something unexpected happened, and all the officials in the palace were in an uproar, all looking at the dozen or so monks whose aura had been leaked.
Mo Fan narrowed his eyes slightly, all the warmth in his eyes converged, a chill suddenly arose, and he shouted in a deep voice: "Red eyes, chattering! Take down these traitors immediately!"
"Subordinates obey orders!"
Red Eyes and Chat answered the order in unison, and their figures suddenly rushed out, turning into two afterimages, and rushed straight towards the monks who were scheming in secret.
"The emperor has an order to capture the traitors and traitors!"
The two demons shouted loudly and struck quickly, fiercely and without mercy.
The other civil and military officials all reacted at this moment. They shared the same hatred and took action to surround the remaining rebels.
The Eternal Hall, which was still a little noisy just now, suddenly fell into a fight, with energy surging and auras flashing around.
But this turmoil did not last long. In just a few breaths, the dust completely settled and silence returned.
More than a dozen civil servants and generals were subdued by the crowd and dragged to the throne of the emperor in embarrassment. They all knelt on the ground.
Everyone looked up and saw that all of the dozen or so people had disheveled hair, messy clothes, and were all in a state of embarrassment.
Some had bleeding from the corners of their mouths and were breathless, while others had bruised and swollen faces, all of which were severely injured after being subdued on the spot.
Among these treasonous traitors, there were only three demon monks, and the remaining seventy-eight percent were all human courtiers who had previously been secretly estranged and criticized.
"Are you aware of your guilt?"
Mo Fan sat on the Supreme Emperor's throne, his eyes narrowed slightly, his voice was calm and calm, but it was filled with a bone-chilling chill that filled the entire Eternal Palace.
Below, the dozens of rebels who were kneeling on their knees all trembled, their spines trembled, and their hearts were shaken. However, no one confessed. They all kept silent and tried to get away with it.
"To remain silent is to admit guilt."
Mo Fan's eyes suddenly turned cold, and a cold snort resounded throughout the court, with murderous intent: "Since you are unwilling to plead guilty and be executed, then all of you will die!"
The majestic killing power was suddenly suppressed, the air under the emperor's throne was stagnant, and the faces of all the rebel officials were instantly ashen.
Faced with the desperate situation of life and death, someone finally couldn't hold on any longer and wailed in a sad voice: "Emperor, please have mercy! Emperor, please have mercy!!"
"Spare your life?"
Mo Fan's eyes were full of anger, his gaze was as sharp as a knife, he stared at the people below, and shouted angrily: "When you are greedy for personal gain, collude with foreign enemies, and hide evil intentions, have you ever thought about the safety of the country and the life and death of hundreds of millions of people?!"
The anger in his heart was hard to calm down.
